jp: 大きな人喰い熊の爪。鉄板を引き裂くほど頑丈であり、一撃で現代イルヴァ生物の顔面を骨ごと吹き飛ばし、攻撃の余波で近くのインド象まで死に至らしめる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～
jp_grezzo: "大きな人喰い熊の爪。鉄板を引き裂くほど頑丈であり、一撃で現代イルヴァ生物の顔面を骨ごと吹き飛ばし、攻撃の余波で近くのインド象まで死に至らしめる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～"
en: The claws of a giant man-eating bear. They are incredibly robust and can even tear through iron sheets. A single strike can blow off an Irva creature's face along with its skull, and the shockwave alone can kill nearby Indian elephants.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The claws of a giant man-eating bear. They are incredibly robust and can even tear through iron sheets. A single strike can blow off an Irva creature's face along with its skull, and the shockwave alone can kill nearby Indian elephants.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Gli artigli di un grande orso mangiatore d'uomini. Sono così robusti da lacerare una lastra di ferro: con un colpo solo spazzano via la faccia, ossa comprese, a una creatura dell'Irva di oggi, e l'onda d'urto arriva ad ammazzare perfino l'elefante indiano lì accanto.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t古の神々が作り上げた、鎖付きの手枷。神の間での使用を想定し、神力による補助なしでとにかく物理的に頑丈に作られている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古の神々が作り上げた、鎖付きの手枷。神の間での使用を想定し、神力による補助なしでとにかく物理的に頑丈に作られている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Chained shackles created by the ancient gods. Intended for the gods, they are made physically sturdy even without supplying divine power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Chained shackles created by the ancient gods. Intended for the gods, they are made physically sturdy even without supplying divine power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Manette con la catena, forgiate dagli dei antichi. Pensate per l'uso al Sigillo Eterno, sono fatte robuste sul piano fisico e basta, senza l'aiuto di alcun potere divino. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t冒険ゼミの受講生に贈られる品。かつては赤剣先生の出す総合問題を突破した者だけに与えられていた。当時はがんばりシールドと言う名称で、冠以外の模様パターンもあったらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t冒険ゼミの受講生に贈られる品。かつては赤剣先生の出す総合問題を突破した者だけに与えられていた。当時はがんばりシールドと言う名称で、冠以外の模様パターンもあったらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Gift given to students of the Adventurer Seminar. In the past, it was given only to those who had broken through the comprehensive questions given by Prof. Redsword. At that time, it was called \"Ganbari Shield\", and there were other patterns besides the crown. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Gift given to students of the Adventurer Seminar. In the past, it was given only to those who had broken through the comprehensive questions given by Prof. Redsword. At that time, it was called \"Ganbari Shield\", and there were other patterns besides the crown. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un oggetto che si dona agli allievi del Seminario d'Avventura. Un tempo lo si dava solo a chi superava la prova del maestro Spada Rossa. Allora si chiamava Scudetto Bravo, e pare che oltre alla corona ci fossero anche altri motivi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t神力を込めると煙を吐く不思議な鏡。初代テスカトリポカがある女神を殺す際に脚を食いちぎられてしまい、義足代わりにこの鏡をくっつけていた時期もあるという。その名は古代語で「夜の鏡」を意味する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神力を込めると煙を吐く不思議な鏡。初代テスカトリポカがある女神を殺す際に脚を食いちぎられてしまい、義足代わりにこの鏡をくっつけていた時期もあるという。その名は古代語で「夜の鏡」を意味する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Mysterious mirror that exhales smoke when imbued with divine power. The first Tezcatlipoca had his leg bitten off while killing a certain goddess, and he attached this mirror to him as a prosthetic leg. Its name means \"Mirror of the Night\" in the ancient language. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Mysterious mirror that exhales smoke when imbued with divine power. The first Tezcatlipoca had his leg bitten off while killing a certain goddess, and he attached this mirror to him as a prosthetic leg. Its name means \"Mirror of the Night\" in the ancient language. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno specchio misterioso che, se lo si carica di potere divino, sputa fumo. Si racconta che il primo Tezcatlipoca, cui una dea aveva staccato una gamba a morsi mentre la uccideva, per un certo tempo se lo sia attaccato addosso al posto della protesi. Il suo nome, in lingua antica, vuol dire \"lo specchio della notte\". \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tニンジャの秘術によって鍛えられた爪。特定の音波に共鳴して振動し、切れ味を高める。詠唱した呪文を増幅し威力を高めることもできるとか。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tニンジャの秘術によって鍛えられた爪。特定の音波に共鳴して振動し、切れ味を高める。詠唱した呪文を増幅し威力を高めることもできるとか。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Claws forged by the secret arts of the ninja. They vibrate in resonance with specific sound waves, enhancing their sharpness. They can also amplify the power of chanted spells. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Claws forged by the secret arts of the ninja. They vibrate in resonance with specific sound waves, enhancing their sharpness. They can also amplify the power of chanted spells. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Artigli temprati con le arti segrete dei ninja. Vibrano entrando in risonanza con certe onde sonore, e così tagliano meglio. Pare che sappiano anche amplificare un incantesimo recitato e renderlo più potente. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t獣や猛禽、虫などの爪を模した装備。樹や地面に引っ掛けるのが本来の使い方。だが攻撃を弾く防具にも、格闘の威力を高める武器にもなるため、専ら戦闘用に使われている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t獣や猛禽、虫などの爪を模した装備。樹や地面に引っ掛けるのが本来の使い方。だが攻撃を弾く防具にも、格闘の威力を高める武器にもなるため、専ら戦闘用に使われている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Equipment that imitates the claws of a beast, bird of prey, insect, etc.Its original use is to hook onto a tree or the ground. However, since it can be used as armor to repel attacks or to enhance the power of weapons, it is used exclusively for combat purposes. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Equipment that imitates the claws of a beast, bird of prey, insect, etc.Its original use is to hook onto a tree or the ground. However, since it can be used as armor to repel attacks or to enhance the power of weapons, it is used exclusively for combat purposes. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un equipaggiamento che imita gli artigli delle bestie, dei rapaci, degli insetti. In origine serviva ad aggrapparsi agli alberi e al terreno; ma siccome fa da armatura per deviare i colpi e insieme da arma per rendere più forte il corpo a corpo, oggi lo si usa soltanto per combattere. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t切り裂いた対象に、不幸をもたらす爪型の武器。かつては触れた者に永遠の不幸をもたらすほどの代物だったが、幸運の女神との戦いの際に力のほとんどを失ってしまった。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t切り裂いた対象に、不幸をもたらす爪型の武器。かつては触れた者に永遠の不幸をもたらすほどの代物だったが、幸運の女神との戦いの際に力のほとんどを失ってしまった。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Claw-shaped weapon that brings misfortune to the target it slices open. It used to bring eternal misfortune to those it touched, but lost most of its power during the battle with the Goddess of Fortune. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Claw-shaped weapon that brings misfortune to the target it slices open. It used to bring eternal misfortune to those it touched, but lost most of its power during the battle with the Goddess of Fortune. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma a forma di artiglio, che porta sfortuna a chi squarcia. Un tempo era roba capace di portare sfortuna eterna a chiunque la sfiorasse, ma nella battaglia contro la dea della fortuna ha perso quasi tutta la sua forza. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t攻防一体の装備。小型の推進装置を内蔵し、加速によって攻撃の貫通力を上げる。一時的に音速を超えて加速するため耐熱・耐衝撃機能も持つ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻防一体の装備。小型の推進装置を内蔵し、加速によって攻撃の貫通力を上げる。一時的に音速を超えて加速するため耐熱・耐衝撃機能も持つ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Offensive-and-defensive equipment. It incorporates a small propulsion device to increase the penetration power of the attack through acceleration. Since it temporarily accelerates above the speed of sound, it is also heat and shock resistant. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Offensive-and-defensive equipment. It incorporates a small propulsion device to increase the penetration power of the attack through acceleration. Since it temporarily accelerates above the speed of sound, it is also heat and shock resistant. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un equipaggiamento che unisce attacco e difesa. Ha un piccolo propulsore incorporato, e l'accelerazione dà al colpo più forza di perforare. Siccome per un attimo accelera oltre la velocità del suono, regge anche il calore e gli urti. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t攻防一体の装備。使用者のマナを転換し光子刃を形成する機能を持つ。隙あらば殴打からそのまま斬撃につなげることができる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻防一体の装備。使用者のマナを転換し光子刃を形成する機能を持つ。隙あらば殴打からそのまま斬撃につなげることができる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Offensive-and-defensive equipment. It has the ability to convert the user's mana to form a photon blade. If there is an opportunity, it can be connected directly from a strike to a slash. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Offensive-and-defensive equipment. It has the ability to convert the user's mana to form a photon blade. If there is an opportunity, it can be connected directly from a strike to a slash. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un equipaggiamento che unisce attacco e difesa. Sa convertire il mana di chi lo impugna e formarne una lama laser. Se trova un varco, dalla botta passa dritto al fendente. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t攻防一体の装備。軽くて丈夫。握りを少し緩めてから回転させて打つこともできる。コンパクトで素早い格闘攻撃を可能とし、目標を次々と粉砕する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻防一体の装備。軽くて丈夫。握りを少し緩めてから回転させて打つこともできる。コンパクトで素早い格闘攻撃を可能とし、目標を次々と粉砕する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Offensive-and-defensive equipment. Light and sturdy. It can be struck by slightly loosening its grip and then rotating it. It enables compact and quick combat attacks, smashing targets one after another. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Offensive-and-defensive equipment. Light and sturdy. It can be struck by slightly loosening its grip and then rotating it. It enables compact and quick combat attacks, smashing targets one after another. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un equipaggiamento che unisce attacco e difesa. Leggero e saldo. Si può anche allentare un poco la presa e colpire facendolo roteare. Permette attacchi corpo a corpo raccolti e svelti, e sbriciola i bersagli uno dopo l'altro. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t攻防一体の装備。斥力シールドの発生装置が取り付けられており、トンファーでありながら高い防御力を発揮する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻防一体の装備。斥力シールドの発生装置が取り付けられており、トンファーでありながら高い防御力を発揮する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Offensive-and-defensive equipment. A repulsive shield generator is attached, which provides high defense despite being a tonfa.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Offensive-and-defensive equipment. A repulsive shield generator is attached, which provides high defense despite being a tonfa.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un equipaggiamento che unisce attacco e difesa. Ci è montato sopra un generatore di scudo repulsivo, e così, pur essendo un tonfa, tiene una difesa alta.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t攻防一体の装備。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻防一体の装備。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Offensive-and-defensive equipment. It allows it's user to sac\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Offensive-and-defensive equipment. It allows it's user to sac\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un equipaggiamento che unisce attacco e difesa.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t第三部用。\n#～謎のメモ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t第三部用。\n#～謎のメモ～\n"
en: \"Reserved for ACT III.\" \n# ~Weird Memo~
en_grezzo: "\"Reserved for ACT III.\" \n# ~Weird Memo~"
it: Per la parte terza. \n# ~Appunto Misterioso~

jp: \t\t呪いの力を封じた騎士盾。結果、盾に宿った「主を守ろうとする、騎士の魂」のみが作用し高い防御力をたたき出す。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t呪いの力を封じた騎士盾。結果、盾に宿った「主を守ろうとする、騎士の魂」のみが作用し高い防御力をたたき出す。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Knight's shield that seals a curse. As a result, the \"knight's soul that tries to protect the lord\" that resides in the shield works to produce a high defensive power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Knight's shield that seals a curse. As a result, the \"knight's soul that tries to protect the lord\" that resides in the shield works to produce a high defensive power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno scudo da cavaliere in cui è stato sigillato il potere di una maledizione. Così agisce soltanto l'\"anima del cavaliere che vuole difendere il suo signore\" rimasta nello scudo, e ne esce una difesa altissima. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tエーテル風で沈んだクイーン・セドナ号の一部。盾として使えないこともないが防御力は心もとない。水に浮くが、溺れている人間一人を支えるのが限界である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tエーテル風で沈んだクイーン・セドナ号の一部。盾として使えないこともないが防御力は心もとない。水に浮くが、溺れている人間一人を支えるのが限界である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Part of the Queen Sedona, which sank in the etheric wind. It can be used as a shield, but its defensive capability is not so good. It floats on water, but it can only support one drowning person. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Part of the Queen Sedona, which sank in the etheric wind. It can be used as a shield, but its defensive capability is not so good. It floats on water, but it can only support one drowning person. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un pezzo della <Regina Sedona>, la nave affondata per il vento d'etere. Come scudo si può anche usare, ma la difesa che dà è poca cosa. Galleggia, però al massimo tiene a galla una persona sola che stia annegando. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t表面に大小様々な棘が付けられた見るからに痛そうな盾。身を守るには少々力不足だが、これを力一杯叩きつけられた時、哀れな敵は苦痛に悶絶することとなろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t表面に大小様々な棘が付けられた見るからに痛そうな盾。身を守るには少々力不足だが、これを力一杯叩きつけられた時、哀れな敵は苦痛に悶絶することとなろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A shield with thorns of various sizes on its surface. It is not strong enough to protect itself, but when it is struck with full force, the poor enemy will scream in agony. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A shield with thorns of various sizes on its surface. It is not strong enough to protect itself, but when it is struck with full force, the poor enemy will scream in agony. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo pieno di spine grandi e piccole sulla faccia, che a guardarlo fa già male. Per difendersi non basta del tutto, ma quando lo si sbatte addosso con tutta la forza, il povero nemico si contorcerà dal dolore. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t古の時代、素晴らしい音色を響かせていたとされるリュート。しかし今日においてそれは単に経年を感じさせない非常に強固な木材を元にした優れた盾として扱われ、最早当時の様な音色を響かせることはないだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古の時代、素晴らしい音色を響かせていたとされるリュート。しかし今日においてそれは単に経年を感じさせない非常に強固な木材を元にした優れた盾として扱われ、最早当時の様な音色を響かせることはないだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: In ancient times, the lute was said to have sounded wonderful. Today, however, it is simply treated as an excellent shield made of very strong wood that does not show its age, and it will never sound as good as it did back then. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "In ancient times, the lute was said to have sounded wonderful. Today, however, it is simply treated as an excellent shield made of very strong wood that does not show its age, and it will never sound as good as it did back then. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un liuto che nei tempi antichi, si dice, mandava un suono meraviglioso. Oggi però lo si tratta soltanto come un ottimo scudo, ricavato da un legno fortissimo su cui gli anni non si vedono, e un suono come quello d'allora non lo darà più. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t非常に分厚く作られた盾。当然ながら重量は半端なものではなく、一度地に落としたら手元に戻すのに数人の力が必要とさえいわれている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に分厚く作られた盾。当然ながら重量は半端なものではなく、一度地に落としたら手元に戻すのに数人の力が必要とさえいわれている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: An extremely bulky shield. Naturally, it is not half as heavy as it should be, and it is said that once it is dropped to the ground, it will require the strength of several people to lift it back up. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "An extremely bulky shield. Naturally, it is not half as heavy as it should be, and it is said that once it is dropped to the ground, it will require the strength of several people to lift it back up. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo fatto spessissimo. Il peso, va da sé, non è cosa da poco: si dice che una volta caduto a terra ci voglia la forza di più persone per rimetterlo in mano. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t大きな長方形をした盾。体を覆う程の大きさを誇る為、敵を遮蔽する為の簡易壁ともなるがその分弊害も多く、扱うには熟練を要するという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大きな長方形をした盾。体を覆う程の大きさを誇る為、敵を遮蔽する為の簡易壁ともなるがその分弊害も多く、扱うには熟練を要するという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A large rectangular shield. It is large enough to cover the body and can be used as a simple wall to shield the enemy, but it also has many harmful effects and requires skill to handle. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A large rectangular shield. It is large enough to cover the body and can be used as a simple wall to shield the enemy, but it also has many harmful effects and requires skill to handle. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo grande e rettangolare. È tanto largo da coprire il corpo, e può fare da muro improvvisato per ripararsi dal nemico; ma proprio per questo dà anche parecchi impicci, e si dice che a maneggiarlo ci voglia esperienza. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t特殊な素材をかけ合わせてより強固な防護を得た盾。やや重いという欠点はあるが、それに有り余る効果を発揮してくれるだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特殊な素材をかけ合わせてより強固な防護を得た盾。やや重いという欠点はあるが、それに有り余る効果を発揮してくれるだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Shields made from a combination of special materials to provide stronger protection. It has the disadvantage of being somewhat heavy, but it just works. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Shields made from a combination of special materials to provide stronger protection. It has the disadvantage of being somewhat heavy, but it just works. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo che, incrociando materiali speciali, ha ottenuto una protezione più solida. Ha il difetto di essere un po' pesante, ma renderà molto più di quel poco che pesa in più. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t攻撃を防ぐために考案された防具。鎧と違い自らの手に持つことで、襲いかかる暴力に相対することができる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻撃を防ぐために考案された防具。鎧と違い自らの手に持つことで、襲いかかる暴力に相対することができる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Protective gear designed to prevent attacks. Unlike armor, it can be held in one's own hands to oppose violence. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Protective gear designed to prevent attacks. Unlike armor, it can be held in one's own hands to oppose violence. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'armatura pensata per parare i colpi. A differenza della corazza la si tiene con la propria mano, e così si può fronteggiare la violenza che ti si getta addosso. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t中心に重心が取り付けられた丸型の盾。その特異な丸型は、戦地へ赴く際に地面に当たって歩行が阻害されぬよう考えだされた結果だと言われている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t中心に重心が取り付けられた丸型の盾。その特異な丸型は、戦地へ赴く際に地面に当たって歩行が阻害されぬよう考えだされた結果だと言われている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Shield with its center of gravity attached to the center. It is said that the round shape of the shield was designed so that it would not hit the ground and impede walking when going into battle. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Shield with its center of gravity attached to the center. It is said that the round shape of the shield was designed so that it would not hit the ground and impede walking when going into battle. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo tondo, col baricentro messo al centro. Si dice che quella forma tonda così particolare sia nata perché, andando al fronte, non battesse per terra e non impedisse di camminare. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t通常のものより小型の盾。腕に装着することで、携行の不便さとそれに伴った重量の軽量化に成功しているが、その代わり防御に使える範囲はかなり狭まっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t通常のものより小型の盾。腕に装着することで、携行の不便さとそれに伴った重量の軽量化に成功しているが、その代わり防御に使える範囲はかなり狭まっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Shields smaller than normal shields. By attaching it to the arm, it succeeds in reducing the inconvenience of carrying it and its weight, but at the same time, the range in which it can be used for defense is considerably narrowed. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Shields smaller than normal shields. By attaching it to the arm, it succeeds in reducing the inconvenience of carrying it and its weight, but at the same time, the range in which it can be used for defense is considerably narrowed. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo più piccolo del normale. Legandolo al braccio si è riusciti a togliere di mezzo la scomodità di portarlo e il peso che ne veniva, ma in cambio lo spazio che si riesce a difendere si è fatto parecchio stretto. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t騎士用に作られた格調高い盾。使う者に合わせ、趣向を凝らした彫金と飾りが付けられているが、単なる儀礼用ではなく、一定の防護も備わっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t騎士用に作られた格調高い盾。使う者に合わせ、趣向を凝らした彫金と飾りが付けられているが、単なる儀礼用ではなく、一定の防護も備わっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A prestigious shield made for knights. They are elaborately engraved and decorated to suit the user, but they are not merely ceremonial and offer a certain degree of protection. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A prestigious shield made for knights. They are elaborately engraved and decorated to suit the user, but they are not merely ceremonial and offer a certain degree of protection. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Uno scudo di gran pregio, fatto per i cavalieri. Porta cesellature e ornamenti lavorati con cura, scelti su misura di chi lo impugna; ma non è soltanto da cerimonia, e una certa protezione ce l'ha. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
